ML Overview - 
we will focus on Supervised Learning. 
What is ML?
Uses algos to learn from data - so that ML algo can later figure out what things are imp. 

Things we could do - just 2 examples - 

Text sentiment analyzis
Email spam detection. 

Metrics - 
Accuracy, Recall, Precision, F1 

accuracy = total correct predictions / total predictions. 

But if we have unbalanced classes - we cant use accuracy. Lets say we have 1 ham and other spam text messages - and our model is wrong and always predicts spam only - then we get 99% accuracy. But when we use it in real life only then will we find out that our model is wrong. 

We will need recall and precision. 

RECALL = true positives / (true positives+false negatives)

PRECISION = true positives / (true positives + false positives)

F1 = 2* (precision * recall) / (precision + recall)
